name: sol-short
rationale: A8 paper exercise of the perp path, not a strategy: a 3x SOL short on Jupiter Perps (paper), opened at random (2% per tick, ~50 s live), closed on a 1% take-profit (the price falling), a 2% stop (the price rising) or after 30 minutes; 10 USD of collateral (30 USD of exposure) a time inside a 30 USD budget. The stop is well inside the 16.55% limit at 3x; borrow is ~0.03 USD an hour at 30 USD.
